name: pidgeon
description: Email inboxes for AI agents: create addresses, read threads, send mail, and receive arriving mail as signed webhooks.

api_key.title: Pidgeon API key
api_key.description: Optional. Leave it empty and Claude Code signs you in to Pidgeon instead. For an agent with nobody there to sign in, a key from https://pidgeon.ai/app/developers/keys, with the narrowest access the agent needs.
